title: Religion
original_lyrics:
[intro]
Well he could almost taste the money but he was sitting in den of
thieves.
Looking for the great awakening trying to find way to leave.

[bridge]
(intro)
He said somebody up there likes me. Now he's working for the holy
guide.
He got drunk but he don't remember that he' been drinking in bar
downtown.
When he thought he heard choir of angels singing in the Tiki Lounge.
And that's when he got religion from no salesman on TV.
Just tap on the shoulder in the parking lot.
He still drinks but he does believe.

[chorus]
Religion, you do the best you can.
We all make the same mistakes, we're gonna wind up with the man.
Religion, oh you do the best you can.

[intro]
We all make the same mistakes, we're gonna wind up with the man.
She was silent as he paid her but the thanks she got was next to none.
And as her car pulled out of the motel, she felt the presence of
someone.
And that's when she got religion in the front of compact Ford.
Just gentle voice on the stereo. Now she's working girl who loves
the Lord.
